triggers.name: area_admin_reason_immutable
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER area_admin_reason_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON area_admin_membership WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.reason IS NOT OLD.reason BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ADMIN_AREA_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE'); END

triggers.name: area_admin_area_active
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER area_admin_area_active BEFORE INSERT ON area_admin_membership WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM area WHERE organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND id=NEW.area_id AND status='active') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ADMIN_AREA_INACTIVE'); END

triggers.name: geo_epoch_area_admin_membership_insert
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER geo_epoch_area_admin_membership_insert AFTER INSERT ON area_admin_membership BEGIN INSERT INTO geo_distribution_epoch(organization_id,epoch) VALUES(NEW.organization_id,1) ON CONFLICT(organization_id) DO UPDATE SET epoch=epoch+1; END

triggers.name: geo_epoch_area_admin_membership_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER geo_epoch_area_admin_membership_delete AFTER DELETE ON area_admin_membership BEGIN INSERT INTO geo_distribution_epoch(organization_id,epoch) VALUES(OLD.organization_id,1) ON CONFLICT(organization_id) DO UPDATE SET epoch=epoch+1; END
